messages:
sasha: Hey team — planning a variant swap for model 'ephemeral-3.2' -> 'ephemeral-3.3' at 16:30 PT. Quiet window requested 16:25-16:40. Can owners ack who's running the swap and doing smokes?

ian: I can run the swap and monitor tail logs. Will be online 16:20.

devon: I'll own smoke tests and quick evals. Running the eval suite in staging now. If anything flakey, will rollback.

maya: Can you confirm pinned alias mapping? We need the catalog alias 'ephemeral-prod' to point to 3.3 after canary passes.

sasha: Good call. Plan is to pin via catalog API after canary: POST /catalog/pin { \"alias\":\"ephemeral-prod\", \"version\":\"ephemeral-3.3\" } — devon, confirm you can run this.

devon: LGTM — also have a small smoke script in case we need quick retries: 
```bash
# smoke.sh
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood/internal/generate -d '{"model":"ephemeral-3.3","prompt":"Hello"}' | jq .
```

maya: On rollback plan — if smokes fail >= 3/5, we'll repoint alias back to 3.2 and scale down canary. Who triggers? ian?

ian: I'll trigger rollback and escalate to @ops-oncall if we see infra errors. I'll also watch latency p95 and error budget.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy for ephemeral-3.3 at 2025-06-03T23:30:00Z (1746000000). Canary fraction 5%. Notifying owners: @ian, @devon.

sasha: Ops checklist:
- owners online
- smoke script ready
- rollback command known
- rollback contact: ops-oncall
- post-deploy eval: perf:latency, cost:tokens, quality:prompt-set-42

devon: smoke script ready. I'll post pass/fail in thread. ETA first smoke 16:33 PT.

maya: Reminder: update runbook with pin timestamp and tag release number. I'll do that after pass.

ian: All set. If no objections I'll start at +2m.

sasha: No objections. Starting +2.

devon: smoke results: 5/5 pass, latency p95 210ms, no errors. Proceeding to pin now.

devon: Pinned via API: {\"alias\":\"ephemeral-prod\",\"version\":\"ephemeral-3.3\",\"pinned_by\":\"devon\",\"ts\":\"1746000180\"}

sasha: Thanks! Monitoring for 10m. If anything spikes, rollback plan ready.

maya: I'll update the runbook and close ticket.

ian: closing notes: scale targets ok. Thx everyone :tada:
